title: Text Generation Service State
description: Generates text with a large language model — a local one via an OpenAI-compatible server or in-process, or a hosted one. (Runtimes: python, cpp, node; IDs: text-generation)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

serverUrl.description: Server backend: base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server

model.description: Server backend: optional model name passed through to the server

modelPath.description: Local backend: path to the .gguf file (~ expands)

contextSize.description: Local backend: context window in tokens

gpuLayers.description: Local backend: layers to offload to GPU (-1 = all)

systemPrompt.description: Prepended when the input has no system message

thinking.description: Server backend: force thinking on/off, for a server whose chat template takes the flag; null sends nothing

stream.description: Generate token by token and notify the growing text as {streamText} (final notification carries streamDone: true) for live chat-bot-style display; the pipeline output is unaffected and still emitted once, when generation finishes. Set false for servers without SSE support

apiKey.description: Write-only; takes a {{secret.…}} reference. The runtime's environment is never read

apiKeyConfigured.description: Read-only: whether a key is configured

endpoint.description: Read-only: the URL this configuration actually reaches

thinkingBudgetTokens.description: Tokens reasoning may use, for a Claude model that thinks on a budget; maxTokens is lifted above it when it is not already

effort.description: Claude only: low, medium, high, xhigh or max — how much the model reasons and writes. Empty is the model's own default

jsonSchema.description: Constrains the answer to a shape — see below

temperature, topK.description: sent while the model is not thinking
